sql_templates.description: Fetch latest insider alerts and bulk deals with technical confirmation for accumulation or distribution clues.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(alert_date) AS max_alert_date FROM signals.insider_alerts),
     latest_stage AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
SELECT i.symbol, i.alert_date, i.alert_type, i.qty, i.value_cr, i.insider_score,
       b.deal_date, b.deal_type, b.qty AS deal_qty, b.price,
       s.stage, s.stage_score, s.technical_score, s.trading_signal
FROM signals.insider_alerts i
JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals b ON i.symbol = b.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON i.symbol = s.symbol
WHERE i.alert_date = (SELECT max_alert_date FROM latest_date)
  AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT max_snapshot_date FROM latest_stage)
  AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY');
